entries.desc: Off mode status says local workflow is usable and production authority is disabled.

evidence.note: Off-mode status smoke and direct CLI check assert mode=off, localWorkflowUsable=true, productionDone=false, receiptVerified=false, canClaimProductionDone=false, and no readinessWarnings.

entries.desc: Shadow/enforce with missing URL or actor key reports actionable readiness gaps without writing receipts.

evidence.note: Shadow with missing URL and enforce with missing URL/actor key/runner id emit actionable readinessWarnings and nextActions while keeping localWorkflowUsable=true and productionDone=false; direct enforce CLI JSON was also spot-checked.

entries.desc: No status/readiness path can claim productionDone or receiptVerified without verified receipt input.

evidence.note: assertNoProductionOverclaim walks authority_status, conduit_status, and conduit_explain JSON responses for off/shadow/enforce/full-env states and fails if productionDone, receiptVerified, canClaimProductionDone, or authorityChanged becomes true without verified receipt.

entries.desc: Docs include local/off, shadow, and enforce runner meanings plus commands to inspect status.

evidence.note: README, docs/guide.md, and authority-client-role.md document off/shadow/enforce meanings, status inspection commands, and prerequisite fields; smoke checks the CLI JSON fields those docs describe.

entries.desc: Docs do not imply paid/server authority is required for normal local story development.

evidence.note: Docs explicitly state off is the default free/local workflow and shadow/enforce readiness gaps are warnings, not requirements for ordinary local story development.

entries.desc: Docs do not say local JSON or status output can satisfy production authority gates.

evidence.note: B-b710 authority-client-role section explicitly states local JSON/status output is non-authoritative; productionDone and receiptVerified stay false until a future verified AuthorityReceipt path exists, mechanically guarded by authority-status-smoke.
